operation.summary: Applet-specific (A Sorta Fairytale About Me only; not a general platform service). Generate a fairytale illustration through the Make Fairytale Image registry task and present it as a full-screen HTML interaction card; existing Azure account quota applies. Requires interactions access too. Stop suppresses late cards.

body.name: presentation_token
body.description: Token from /story or /story/presentation; Stop invalidates it

body.name: request_id
body.description: Stable idempotency key for this story image, 8–128 letters/digits/dash/underscore; reuse on an unknown outcome

operation.example: POST /v1/story/image {"presentation_token":"1","title":"The tiny kingdom","narration":"Once upon a time…","request_id":"fairytale-12345678"}
operation.returns: interaction_id, task_key, model, quota, display {shown_as, full_screen, missing?, fix?}; picture bytes stay on the phone and do not cross the card response bridge
